decision: keep the internal key as the int handle, not the UUID
why: the journal changes, parquet columns, nanashi_cell_change coords and workspace conflicts already use handles; UUID keys would change all of those formats

decision: captured the test baseline before any change
why: so each unit compares against the old result

decision: split the work into 6 units, each green on both engines: metrics, dimensions+properties, members, persistence, server, api
why: each unit changes one kind of key, so a break shows at the unit that caused it

decision: keep the public Python API name-based and also accept int handles
why: about 295 test calls use names; the server can pass handles

decision: gave unit 1 (metrics by handle) to a fresh subagent
why: the change crosses every module; the main thread keeps review and the gates
